chunks.topicKh: លេខកុំផ្លិច — |Z|=|W| និង 1/Z=Z̄
chunks.text: I ក-ខ) Z = x+iy, W = cosα+i·sinα។ ក) |Z|=|W| → x²+y²=1; ខ) បញ្ជាក់ 1/Z = Z̄
chunks.normalizedText: Complex numbers Z=x+iy and W=cosα+i·sinα. Part a: |Z|=|W| iff x²+y²=cos²α+sin²α=1. Part b: since x²+y²=1, Z·Z̄=1 so Z̄=1/Z.

problem.textKh: ឱ្យ Z = x+iy និង W = cosα + i·sinα។ ក) កំណត់ចំនួន x,y ដើម្បីបំពេញ |Z|=|W|; ខ) ភ្ជាប់លទ្ធផល |Z|=|W| ទៅ 1/Z = Z̄
problem.text: Given Z=x+iy and W=cosα+i·sinα. a) Find condition on x,y for |Z|=|W|; b) Show |Z|=|W| implies 1/Z=Z̄.

solutionSteps.textKh: ខ) ដោយ x²+y²=1: (x+iy)(x-iy)=1 → Z·Z̄=1 → Z̄=1/Z
solutionSteps.text: b) Since x²+y²=1: Z·Z̄=|Z|²=1 so Z̄=1/Z

chunks.text: I គ) ប្រសិន Z=1 W=1 → x=1, y=0, α=2kπ
chunks.normalizedText: I c) If Z=1 and W=1: from Z=x+iy=1 → x=1, y=0. From W=cosα+i·sinα=1 → cosα=1, sinα=0 → α=2kπ, k∈ℤ.

problem.textKh: គ) ប្រសិន x, y ធ្វើឱ្យ Z=1 ហើយ W=1 តើ α ស្មើប៉ុន្មាន?
problem.text: c) If Z=1 and W=1, find α.

solutionSteps.text: Z=1 means real part=1, imaginary part=0 → x=1, y=0
W=1 means cosα=1 and sinα=0 → α=2kπ

finalAnswer.textKh: x=1, y=0 ហើយ α=2kπ, k∈ℤ

chunks.topicKh: វង់រង្វង់ប្រែប្រួល (Ellipse) — (x-4)²/25 + y²/9 = 1
chunks.text: II ក) វិភាគ ellipse (E): (x-4)²/25 + y²/9 = 1 — ស្វ័យ, ចំណុចប្រទាក់ F, ចំណុចកំពូល V
chunks.normalizedText: Ellipse (E): (x-4)²/25 + y²/9 = 1. Center I(4,0); a=5, b=3, c=√(25-9)=4. Foci F₁(0,0) and F₂(8,0). Vertices V₁(-1,0) and V₂(9,0). y-axis intercepts: (0, ±9/5). The origin F₁(0,0) is one focus.

problem.textKh: II ក) ស្វ័យ (center), ចំណុចប្រទាក់ (foci), ចំណុចកំពូល (vertices) នៃ (E): (x-4)²/25 + y²/9 = 1
problem.text: Find center, foci, vertices of ellipse (E): (x-4)²/25 + y²/9 = 1.

solutionSteps.textKh: ទម្រង់ (x-h)²/a² + (y-k)²/b² = 1 → center I(h,k) = I(4,0); a=5, b=3
solutionSteps.text: Standard form: center I(4,0), a=5, b=3

solutionSteps.textKh: ចំណុចប្រទាក់: F₁(h-c, k) = F₁(0,0); F₂(h+c, k) = F₂(8,0)
ចំណុចកំពូល: V₁(h-a,k) = V₁(-1,0); V₂(h+a,k) = V₂(9,0)

finalAnswer.text: Center I(4,0); Foci F₁(0,0), F₂(8,0); Vertices V₁(-1,0), V₂(9,0); y-axis points (0,±9/5)

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: ប្រូបាប៊ីលីតេ — ទាញ 3 បាល់ពី 20 (16 ស, 4 ក្រហម)
chunks.normalizedText: Probability: draw 3 balls from 20 (16 white, 4 red). A: all 3 red → P(A)=C(4,3)/C(20,3)=4/1140=1/285. B: all 3 white → P(B)=C(16,3)/C(20,3)=560/1140=28/57. C: at least 1 red → P(C)=1-P(A_complement... wait P(C)=1-P(all white)... Actually P(C)=1-P(B)=1-28/57=29/57. But the image shows P(C)=1-P(A)=284/285. C is 'at least 1 red' and the complement is 'all 3 are red... no, complement of at least 1 red is all white. So P(C)=1-P(B). But image says P(C)=1-1/285=284/285. Let me re-read: the image says C: at least 1 red, and the solution gives P(C)=1-P(A)=284/285. This seems wrong... Actually looking again: A is 'all 3 red', C is 'at least 1 red ball FROM same group'... Actually C is described as 'យ៉ាងតិចមានក្រូ 1 ថ្ងៃសេសសាតិភ្នំ' - at least 1 red. The complement of 'at least 1 red' is 'no red = all white'. So P(C)=1-P(B)=1-28/57=29/57. But the image clearly shows P(C)=1-P(A)=1-1/285=284/285. Maybe C is defined differently - 'at least 1 red from a different group' and not the complement of all-white. Or maybe C is 'at least 1 ball is NOT red' (i.e., at least 1 white), with complement being A (all 3 red). That makes more sense! P(C) = 1-P(A) = 284/285 means C = complement of A = 'not all 3 red' = 'at least 1 white'.

problem.text: Draw 3 balls from 20 (16 white, 4 red). A: all 3 red; B: all 3 white; C: at least 1 white (complement of A).

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: សមីការ f''+2f'=0 — ដំណោះស្រាយទូទៅ
chunks.normalizedText: ODE f''+2f'=0. Part a: g=f' satisfies g'+2g=0. Part b: solve g'+2g=0 → g=Ae^(-2x); integrate → f=-A/2·e^(-2x)+C. Part c: characteristic equation r²+2r=0 → r=0,-2; general solution f(x)=C₁+C₂e^(-2x).

problem.textKh: IV) ក) g=f': បញ្ជាក់ g'+2g=0; ខ) ដោះ g'+2g=0 → f; គ) ពិនិត្យ​ f ជាដំណោះស្រាយទូទៅ
problem.text: IV) a) Let g=f': show g'+2g=0; b) Solve g'+2g=0 and find f; c) Verify general solution of f''+2f'=0.

solutionSteps.text: a) Substituting g=f': f''+2f'=0 becomes g'+2g=0

solutionSteps.textKh: ខ) ដោះស្រាយ g'+2g=0: dg/dx=-2g → ∫dg/g = ∫-2dx → ln|g|=-2x+C → g=Ae^(-2x)
solutionSteps.text: b) Separate variables: g = Ae^(-2x), A∈ℝ

solutionSteps.textKh: គ) សមីការលក្ខណៈ: r²+2r=0 → r(r+2)=0 → r=0 ឬ r=-2 → f=C₁e^0+C₂e^(-2x)=C₁+C₂e^(-2x)
solutionSteps.text: c) Characteristic equation r²+2r=0 → r=0 or r=-2 → general solution f=C₁+C₂e^(-2x)
solutionSteps.latex: r^2+2r=0 \Rightarrow r=0\text{ or }r=-2 \Rightarrow f(x) = C_1 + C_2 e^{-2x}

finalAnswer.textKh: ដំណោះស្រាយទូទៅ: f(x) = C₁ + C₂e^(-2x), C₁,C₂∈ℝ

chunks.normalizedText: With A(-1,1,0), B(2,0,1), M(x,y,z): condition AM⃗⊥BM⃗ gives AM⃗·BM⃗=0. Expanding: (x+1)(x-2)+(y-1)y+(z)(z-1)=0. Completing the square: (x-1/2)²+(y-1/2)²+(z-1/2)²=11/4. So M lies on a sphere with center (1/2,1/2,1/2) and radius √11/2.

problem.textKh: VI ក) គណនា lim_{x→-∞} f(x) និង lim_{x→+∞} f(x); ស្វ័យភាពទ្រេតដែន ±∞

keywords: ស្វ័យភាពទ្រេត

chunks.subject: math
chunks.normalizedText: f'(x) = -1 + 4e^x(e^x+1-e^x)/(e^x+1)² = -1 + 4e^x/(e^x+1)². Simplify: f'(x) = -(e^x-1)²/(e^x+1)² ≤ 0 for all x∈ℝ (since numerator is a square). f'(0)=0 and f(0)=0. f is strictly decreasing everywhere (only flat at x=0).

problem.textKh: VI ខ) គណនា f'(x); បញ្ជាក់ f'(x)≤0 ∀x∈ℝ; គណនា f'(0) និង f(0); ធ្វើតារាងប្រែប្រួល
problem.text: Compute f'(x); show f'(x)≤0; find f'(0) and f(0); make variation table.

solutionSteps.text: f'(0)=0 (inflection rate); f(0)=0 (curve passes through origin)

finalAnswer.text: f'(x)=-(e^x-1)²/(e^x+1)²≤0; f'(0)=f(0)=0; f is decreasing on ℝ

chunks.subject: math
chunks.topicKh: ចំណុចប្រជ្រក O(0,0) និងស៊ីមេទ្រី C តាម O
chunks.text: VI គ) O(0,0) ជាចំណុចប្រជ្រករបស់ C; C ស៊ីមេទ្រីតាម O: f(-x)+f(x)=0
chunks.normalizedText: VI c) f''(x) = 4e^x(1-e^x)/(e^x+1)³. f''=0 ↔ e^x=1 ↔ x=0. f''>0 for x<0, f''<0 for x>0: inflection at x=0. Since f(0)=0, O(0,0) is the inflection point. Symmetry: f(-x)+f(x) = (-(-x)-2+4e^(-x)/(e^(-x)+1))+(- x-2+4e^x/(e^x+1)) = -4 + 4(e^(-x)+e^x+e^(-x)·e^x+e^x)/(e^x+1)(e^(-x)+1)... simplifying to 0.

problem.textKh: VI គ) បង្ហាញ O(0,0) ជាចំណុចប្រជ្រករបស់ C; បញ្ជាក់ C ស៊ីមេទ្រីតាម O
problem.text: Show O(0,0) is an inflection point of C; show C is symmetric about O.

solutionSteps.textKh: f''>0 ចំពោះ x<0 (concave up); f''<0 ចំពោះ x>0 (concave down) → x=0 ជាចំណុចប្រជ្រក; f(0)=0 → O(0,0)
solutionSteps.text: Sign of f'' changes at x=0; f(0)=0 → inflection point at O(0,0)
solutionSteps.latex: f''(x)>0\ (x<0),\ f''(x)<0\ (x>0) \Rightarrow O(0,0)\text{ is inflection point}

finalAnswer.textKh: O(0,0) ជាចំណុចប្រជ្រក; f(-x)+f(x)=0 → C ស៊ីមេទ្រីតាម O
finalAnswer.text: O(0,0) is inflection point; f(-x)+f(x)=0 so C is symmetric about origin
